facts.Funding Trigger: At acceptance / after standard legal checks; typically wired within ~3 weeks
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: $200K uncapped MFN SAFE + $20K Post-Money CEA for 5% common; side letter includes pro-rata and other rights
facts.Company Required at Application: No; company must be incorporated in a Techstars-acceptable US/foreign equivalent structure before investment closes
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage startups. Accepted founders must work exclusively on the startup, without other employment or study. Techstars invests after incorporation, ownership, IP and bank-account checks.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Deep customer pain, fast execution and a market with potential for more than $1B annual revenue, including health, climate, AI, fintech and SaaS.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Hybrid; required in-person sessions at start, midpoint and Demo Day in NYC.
facts.International Founder: Yes — founders can be based anywhere
facts.Application Materials: Techstars application: profile, company information, demo video, deck, team video, traction, revenue, funding and go-to-market strategy.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Early stage stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
